rules: All services run in Docker. No direct host installs for postgresql/redis
Port assignments are fixed: backend=3000, frontend=5173, wiki=3001, postgres=5432, redis=6379
Separate postgres instance for tests on port 5433. Never run tests against main DB
All containers have health checks defined in docker-compose.yml
Backend Docker image: multi-stage. Final stage FROM node:20-alpine, USER node, dumb-init as PID 1
Environment variables are never baked into Docker images. Injected at runtime via .env files
docker-compose.yml is the source of truth for local development service config
Migrations run automatically on container start in development. Manual run in production
Database volumes are named volumes (not bind mounts) to avoid permission issues on Windows
All backend/frontend/wiki Dockerfiles include .dockerignore excluding node_modules and .env
